sum: Boxabl Inc. develops and sells modular homes in the United States. It offers Building Box, which consists of room modules that ship to site at a low cost and can be stacked and connected to build various shape and style of finished buildings. The company's product includes casita Box comprising kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, and living area. The company was formerly known as FG Merger II Corp and changed its name to Boxabl Inc. in June 2026. The company is based in North Las Vegas, Nevada.
ceo: Mr. Paolo  Tiramani (Founder, Co-CEO, President, Chief Eng. & Strategy Officer, Secretary & Exec. Chairman)
